ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Utinni — Rust Cathedral Roaches
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
RUST_CATHEDRAL_MECHANICS_1 §6 (the roaches — the land cleaners), owner addendum 2026-09-07, verbatim: "reskin the cockroaches mod to pertain to the Scarlands around the Rust Cathedral and the Rust Cathedral itself. Both organic and artificial versions. Make them much smaller and the synthetic ones strangely tough and powerful. Cleaners of the area on land like the eels that live in the coolant rivers."
Donor: LingLuo.Cockroach (workshop 3196253802, "Rim cockroach"), already active in the mod list. MEASURED independently this pass (dnfile metadata enumeration of Ling_Cockroach.dll plus a direct read of the donor's own 1.6/Defs/Normal.xml and Patches/Core.xml — not copied from the kit spec blind): exactly 5 TypeDefs in the whole assembly (ThinkNode_EatWastepack, JobDriver_EatWastepack, Toils_FenXi, Hediff_DeadBombToQiaoKeli, Verb_JumpToFace), no HarmonyLib reference, no game-wide hook — every class binds only where a def references it. The donor's one patch (Patches/Core.xml) does exactly one PatchOperationAdd, donor-scoped (ResurrectMediumMech's ingredient filter), irrelevant here. An XML-clone reskin is therefore safe and this mod is exactly that: CLONE, never patch-in-place. The donor mod itself is untouched and stays active for its own two creatures; nothing below references any of its classes, comps or recipes.
Two new races, both bodySize-shrunk from the donor's 2 down to "small scuttling thing" scale — deliberately, per stat, never by a flat "scale all attributes" (bodySize does not scale melee damage or armor):
- RUT_ScarRoach (organic, AnimalThingBase, bodySize 0.25) — roams the Scarlands' scar-dust in loose colonies (wildBiomes: RUT_Scarlands). Light armor (0.2/0.15), modest bite (4), high Wildness (0.9), no taming hook this pass. - RUT_CathedralRoach (synthetic, BaseMechanoidWalker, bodySize 0.22, own BodyDef RUT_RoachHex rather than the donor's Scorcher_SixLeg so this def never depends on the donor mod's presence) — donor-comparable armor (0.75/0.75) at a healthScale (1.6) that reads "strangely tough and powerful" for its size, exactly as the owner asked. Wild fauna, not a player-craftable mech: no RecipeDef, no turret verb, no death-bomb hediff. Wild-spawn wiring for mechanoid presence is a SEPARATE axis in this campaign (the_rust_cathedral.json roster's own "confidence" entry: mechanoid/Sentinel presence is "EXCLUDED BY DESIGN... never encoded in wild rosters") — this def carries no <wildBiomes> entry; it rides whatever already spawns the roster's other mech-vermin (GR_Mecharat). ❓ UNVERIFIED without a live quicktest, which this pass did not run.
Both are "cleaners, not vermin" — the land counterpart to the coolant eels — via RM_EatCleanableExtension / RM_ThinkNode_EatCleanable (mandrake.rm.creaturebehaviors, this item's one new C# class): a generic, data-driven "forage a named item and/or filth, then consume it" mechanism that generalizes the donor's measured ThinkNode_EatWastepack in the two ways the task specified — no player-faction gate (fires for wild pawns too, via the shared engine's Animal_PreMain insertTag) and filth is a first-class target alongside named items (Wastepack), not just wastepacks.
NOT wired to any hum-mood/attitude system (owner ruling, 2026-09-07: "leave the roaches out of the hum mechanics for now") — RM_MapComponent_BiomeAttitude does not exist yet regardless (a different, unbuilt section of this item), and nothing here references it. No freeze/scatter tell.
Salability — DECIDED (kit spec §6): both roaches join the salable list. The organic butchers normally (useMeatFrom Megaspider, like the donor). The synthetic's butcherProducts include RUT_CathedralRoachShell, a small new tradeable resource (ThingDefs_Items/RUT_CathedralRoachShell.xml), alongside steel. Neither is "watched" by any hum/goodwill mechanic — no comp here counts or reports a harvest; this is deliberate (rationale: leaving the roaches out of hum inputs as well as hum displays), reversible on the owner's word like the ruling it follows.
Deferred, NOT built this pass (all noted, none silently dropped): a taming/pet register, a synthetic-roach death sting, and bespoke art — every texPath below is a placeholder (magenta/missing in-game until the art pipe runs); do not read a texPath's presence as art having shipped.
Roster wiring: design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/rosters/the_rust_cathedral.json and the_scarlands.json fauna arrays updated to point at these new defNames in place of the donor's Ling_Cockroach entry, which the roster had placed in the Cathedral itself (an earlier reading, predating this addendum's organic/synthetic biome split).
